tools.name: rlm.delegate

params.task: string - the sub-task for the child agent
params.allow: list of strings - tool names the child can use

tools.desc: Spawn a child agent to handle a multi-step sub-task. Use for commands that need multiple tool calls (e.g. 'set a reminder and send an email'). Returns the child's result as text.

params.name: string - exact FoxMCP browser tool name

tools.desc: Run local Python for calculations, parsing attached files, and transforming research results. Output is capped and execution is time-limited.

notes: Router maps STT text -> LLM (Qwen3-0.6B fine-tune); LLM emits {tool, params} JSON or none. Hinglish variants welcome in training data. Destructive power actions are intentionally excluded from the LLM tool schema.
